matchup_findings.statement: Toledo's defense out-rates the opposing offense on a down-to-down basis (-2.36 for Sacramento State's offense).
Toledo holds the early-down edge: its offense stays ahead of the chains on 1st and 2nd down against this defense (+0.68) more than Sacramento State does (-2.85).

Toledo owns the stronger opponent-adjusted explosive-play matchup: Sacramento State offense vs Toledo defense -2.57, Toledo offense vs Sacramento State defense +1.67 (explosive-play rate, opponent-adjusted: Toledo offense #28 of 138, Sacramento State defense #122 of 138).

Toledo owns the stronger opponent-adjusted finishing matchup: Sacramento State offense vs Toledo defense -1.93, Toledo offense vs Sacramento State defense +1.79 (points per scoring opportunity, opponent-adjusted: Toledo offense #57 of 138, Sacramento State defense #129 of 138).
Toledo's explosive passing offense meets a Sacramento State defense that allows explosive pass plays (+2.73).

Toledo owns the stronger opponent-adjusted scoring matchup: Sacramento State offense vs Toledo defense -1.32, Toledo offense vs Sacramento State defense +2.65 (points per game, opponent-adjusted: Toledo offense #30 of 138, Sacramento State defense #133 of 138).

Toledo owns the stronger opponent-adjusted sustained-efficiency matchup: Sacramento State offense vs Toledo defense -2.36, Toledo offense vs Sacramento State defense +1.16 (success rate, opponent-adjusted: Toledo offense #66 of 138, Sacramento State defense #94 of 138).

Toledo's passing offense meets a Sacramento State defense it out-rates on the matchup scale (+1.75) (pass success rate, opponent-adjusted: Toledo offense #50 of 138, Sacramento State defense #118 of 138).
Sacramento State's offense has given the ball away at a high rate (+1.35 SD). Regression-prone: reported as volatility, never as a cause on its own.

pace.definition: possession_environment = (z of home offense plays + z of away defense plays allowed + z of away offense plays + z of home defense plays allowed) / 2, on adjusted values. Positive = more snaps than an average FBS game. tempo_environment = -(z of each offense's possession seconds per play) / 2

volatility.definition: offense_ypp_residual_sd = game-to-game spread of the offense's yards per play around what the fit expected against each opponent; its percentile is within the FBS universe. explosive_yard_share_z is the raw share standardised across FBS (not opponent-adjusted). takeaways_per_game_z and giveaways_per_game_z are RAW per-game turnover counts standardised across FBS: turnovers are regression-prone and are deliberately not opponent-adjusted.

adjusted_unavailable_reason: descriptive tendency: opponent adjustment does not apply to this metric (V1)

scoring_baseline.label: opponent-adjusted scoring baseline -- descriptive, uncalibrated, NOT a projection

early_down_success_rate.description: Success rate on 1st and 2nd down only.
early_down_success_rate.name: Early-down success rate

explosive_play_rate.description: Share of scrimmage plays gaining 12+ (rush) or 16+ (pass) yards.
explosive_play_rate.name: Explosive-play rate

explosive_yard_share.description: How much of the offense's yardage arrived in explosive chunks. Dependence, not quality.
explosive_yard_share.name: Share of yards from explosive plays

first_down_rate.description: First downs (all methods) / offensive plays. A box-score proxy for staying on schedule.
first_down_rate.name: First downs per play

havoc_allowed.description: (Tackles for loss + passes defended by the opposing defense) / offensive plays. A havoc PROXY: turnovers are deliberately excluded so repeatable disruption stays separate from turnover luck.
havoc_allowed.name: Havoc rate (TFL + PD)

interception_rate.description: Interceptions thrown / pass attempts. Regression-prone; never carries a script alone.
interception_rate.name: Interception rate

net_yards_per_dropback.description: Sack-adjusted: passing yards minus sack yardage, per dropback (attempts + sacks).
net_yards_per_dropback.name: Net yards per dropback

neutral_pass_rate.description: Dropbacks / plays in quarters 1-3 with the score within 14. A tendency, not adjusted.
neutral_pass_rate.name: Neutral-situation pass rate

pass_rate.description: Pass attempts / plays. A tendency; game state drives it, so it is not opponent-adjusted.
pass_rate.name: Pass rate (all situations)

pass_success_rate.description: Success rate on dropbacks (sacks included as failures).
pass_success_rate.name: Pass success rate

plays_per_game.description: Offensive plays per game. Direction is descriptive (more plays = more possessions).
plays_per_game.name: Plays per game

points_per_drive.description: Offensive points (TD=7, FG=3) per offensive drive.
points_per_drive.name: Points per drive

points_per_game.description: Points scored, all phases (includes defensive and special-teams scores).
points_per_game.name: Points per game

points_per_opportunity.description: Offensive points per drive that reached the opponent's 40 (TD=7, FG=3).
points_per_opportunity.name: Points per scoring opportunity

rush_success_rate.description: Success rate on designed runs (sacks excluded).
rush_success_rate.name: Rush success rate

sack_rate_allowed.description: Sacks taken / (pass attempts + sacks), from both teams' box scores. Repeatable disruption.
sack_rate_allowed.name: Sack rate

seconds_per_play.description: Time of possession / offensive plays. Lower = faster. Direction is descriptive only.
seconds_per_play.name: Possession seconds per play

success_rate.description: Share of non-garbage scrimmage plays gaining 50%/70%/100% of the distance on 1st/2nd/3rd-4th down.
success_rate.name: Success rate

third_down_rate.description: SECONDARY evidence: small samples, heavily dependent on distance-to-go.
third_down_rate.name: Third-down conversion rate

turnovers_per_game.description: Giveaways per game. Regression-prone; reported, never a script's sole cause.
turnovers_per_game.name: Turnovers per game

yards_per_designed_rush.description: Rushing yards per designed run, sacks removed (play log).
yards_per_designed_rush.name: Yards per designed rush

yards_per_pass_attempt.description: Passing yards / pass attempts (box). Not sack-adjusted.
yards_per_pass_attempt.name: Yards per pass attempt

yards_per_play.description: Total offensive yards / (rush attempts + pass attempts). NCAA box: sacks count as rushes.
yards_per_play.name: Yards per play

yards_per_rush.description: NCAA box-score rushing: sacks are counted as rushes with negative yardage.
yards_per_rush.name: Yards per rush (box)
